{{Top|leg}}
'''Firespice''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] regarded for its pungent taste. Newcomers to the restaurant [[Pepper's Pax]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] were required to eat a mouthful of firespice [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetable]] pods to prove their fortitude. Those who failed the test were rudely removed from the premises.
